# hcloudplus_activities (Data Source)

Cross-project audit activities. Reads GET /_activities. Time window is capped at 31 days by Hetzner.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hcloudplus_activities" "recent_token_ops" {
  include_user_activities = false
  types                   = ["token.create", "token.delete"]
  created_after           = timeadd(timestamp(), "-24h")
}

output "recent_token_events" {
  value = data.hcloudplus_activities.recent_token_ops.activities
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `created_after` (String) RFC 3339 lower time bound.
- `created_before` (String) RFC 3339 upper time bound. Window capped at 31 days.
- `include_user_activities` (Boolean) Include account-level events (logins, etc). At least one of include_user_activities or project_ids is required.
- `per_page` (Number) Page size (default 25, max 500).
- `project_ids` (List of Number) Filter to specific project IDs.
- `types` (List of String) Filter by activity type (e.g. 'server.create', 'token.create').

### Read-Only

- `activities` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--activities))

<a id="nestedatt--activities"></a>
